verses.en: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
verses.pt: Paulo, chamado para ser apóstolo de Jesus Cristo pela vontade de Deus, e o irmão Sóstenes,
verses.en_web: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
verses.en_bbe: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ by the purpose of God, and Sosthenes the brother,

verses.en: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:
verses.pt: à igreja de Deus que está em Corinto, aos santificados em Cristo Jesus, chamados para serem santos, com todos os que em todo lugar invocam o nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, Senhor deles e nosso:
verses.en_web: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth; those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:
verses.en_bbe: To the church of God which is in Corinth, to those who have been made holy in Christ Jesus, saints by the selection of God, with all those who in every place give honour to the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours:

verses.en: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Graça seja convosco, e paz, da parte de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;
verses.pt: Sempre dou graças a Deus por vós, pela graça de Deus que vos foi dada em Cristo Jesus;
verses.en_web: I always thank my God concerning you, for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus;
verses.en_bbe: I give praise to my God for you at all times, because of the grace of God which has been given to you in Christ Jesus;

verses.en: That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;
verses.pt: porque em tudo fostes enriquecidos nele, em toda palavra e em todo o conhecimento,
verses.en_web: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge;
verses.en_bbe: So that in him you have wealth in all things, in word and in knowledge of every sort;

verses.en: Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
verses.pt: assim como o testemunho de Cristo foi confirmado entre vós;
verses.en_web: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
verses.en_bbe: Even as the witness of the Christ has been made certain among you:

verses.en: So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.pt: de maneira que nenhum dom vos falta, enquanto aguardais a manifestação de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,
verses.en_web: so that you come behind in no gift; waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.en_bbe: So that having every grace you are living in the hope of the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ;

verses.en: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: o qual também vos confirmará até o fim, para serdes irrepreensíveis no dia de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Who will give you strength to the end, to be free from all sin in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.pt: Fiel é Deus, pelo qual fostes chamados para a comunhão de seu Filho Jesus Cristo nosso Senhor.
verses.en_web: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ, our Lord.
verses.en_bbe: God is true, through whom you have been given a part with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.en: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
verses.pt: Rogo-vos, irmãos, em nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que sejais concordes no falar, e que não haja dissensões entre vós; antes sejais unidos no mesmo pensamento e no mesmo parecer.
verses.en_web: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
verses.en_bbe: Now I make request to you, my brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you will all say the same thing, and that there may be no divisions among you, so that you may be in complete agreement, in the same mind and in the same opinion.

verses.en: For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.
verses.pt: Pois a respeito de vós, irmãos meus, fui informado pelos da família de Cloé que há contendas entre vós.
verses.en_web: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.
verses.en_bbe: Because it has come to my knowledge, through those of the house of Chloe, that there are divisions among you, my brothers.

verses.en: Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.
verses.pt: Quero dizer com isto, que cada um de vós diz: Eu sou de Paulo; ou, Eu de Apolo; ou Eu sou de Cefas; ou, Eu de Cristo.
verses.en_web: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”
verses.en_bbe: That is, that some of you say, I am of Paul; some say, I am of Apollos; some say, I am of Cephas; and some say, I am Christ's.

verses.en: Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?
verses.pt: será que Cristo está dividido? foi Paulo crucificado por amor de vós? ou fostes vós batizados em nome de Paulo?
verses.en_web: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?
verses.en_bbe: Is there a division in Christ? was Paul nailed to the cross for you? or were you given baptism in the name of Paul?

verses.en: I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;
verses.pt: Dou graças a Deus que a nenhum de vós batizei, senão a Crispo e a Gaio;
verses.en_web: I thank God that I baptized none of you, except Crispus and Gaius,
verses.en_bbe: I give praise to God that not one of you had baptism from me, but Crispus and Gaius;

verses.en: Lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.
verses.pt: para que ninguém diga que fostes batizados em meu nome.
verses.en_web: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.
verses.en_bbe: So that no one may be able to say that you had baptism in my name.

verses.en: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
verses.pt: É verdade, batizei também a família de Estéfanas, além destes, não sei se batizei algum outro.
verses.en_web: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)
verses.en_bbe: And I gave baptism to the house of Stephanas; but I am not certain that any others had baptism from me.

verses.en: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.
verses.pt: Porque Cristo não me enviou para batizar, mas para pregar o evangelho; não em sabedoria de palavras, para não se tornar vã a cruz de Cristo.
verses.en_web: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.
verses.en_bbe: For Christ sent me, not to give baptism, but to be a preacher of the good news: not with wise words, for fear that the cross of Christ might be made of no value.

verses.en: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
verses.pt: Porque a palavra da cruz é deveras loucura para os que perecem; mas para nós, que somos salvos, é o poder de Deus.
verses.en_web: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are saved it is the power of God.
verses.en_bbe: For the word of the cross seems foolish to those who are on the way to destruction; but to us who are on the way to salvation it is the power of God.

verses.en: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.
verses.pt: porque está escrito: Destruirei a sabedoria dos sábios, e aniquilarei a sabedoria o entendimento dos entendidos.
verses.en_web: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”
verses.en_bbe: As it says in the holy Writings, I will put an end to the wisdom of the wise, and will put on one side the designs of those who have knowledge.

verses.en: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
verses.pt: Onde está o sábio? Onde o escriba? Onde o questionador deste século? Porventura não tornou Deus louca a sabedoria deste mundo?
verses.en_web: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the lawyer of this world? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
verses.en_bbe: Where is the wise? where is he who has knowledge of the law? where is the man of this world who has a love of discussion? has not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

verses.en: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.
verses.pt: Visto como na sabedoria de Deus o mundo pela sua sabedoria não conheceu a Deus, aprouve a Deus salvar pela loucura da pregação os que crêem.
verses.en_web: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.
verses.en_bbe: For because, by the purpose of God, the world, with all its wisdom, had not the knowledge of God, it was God's pleasure, by so foolish a thing as preaching, to give salvation to those who had faith in him.

verses.en: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:
verses.pt: Pois, enquanto os judeus pedem sinal, e os gregos buscam sabedoria,
verses.en_web: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,
verses.en_bbe: Seeing that the Jews make request for signs, and the Greeks are looking for knowledge:

verses.en: But we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;
verses.pt: nós pregamos a Cristo crucificado, que é escândalo para os judeus, e loucura para os gregos,
verses.en_web: but we preach Christ crucified; a stumbling block to Jews, and foolishness to Greeks,
verses.en_bbe: But we give the good news of Christ on the cross, a hard thing to the Jews, and a foolish thing to the Gentiles;

verses.en: But unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.
verses.pt: mas para os que são chamados, tanto judeus como gregos, Cristo, poder de Deus, e sabedoria de Deus.
verses.en_web: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God.
verses.en_bbe: But to those of God's selection, Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power and the wisdom of God.

verses.en: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
verses.pt: Porque a loucura de Deus é mais sábia que os homens; e a fraqueza de Deus é mais forte que os homens.
verses.en_web: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
verses.en_bbe: Because what seems foolish in God is wiser than men; and what seems feeble in God is stronger than men.

verses.en: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:
verses.pt: Ora, vede, irmãos, a vossa vocação, que não são muitos os sábios segundo a carne, nem muitos os poderosos. nem muitos os nobres que são chamados.
verses.en_web: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
verses.en_bbe: For you see God's design for you, my brothers, that he has not taken a great number of the wise after the flesh, not the strong, not the noble:

verses.en: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
verses.pt: Pelo contrário, Deus escolheu as coisas loucas do mundo para confundir os sábios; e Deus escolheu as coisas fracas do mundo para confundir as fortes;
verses.en_web: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world, that he might put to shame the things that are strong;
verses.en_bbe: But God made selection of the foolish things of this world so that he might put the wise to shame; and the feeble things that he might put to shame the strong;

verses.en: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
verses.pt: e Deus escolheu as coisas ignóbeis do mundo, e as desprezadas, e as que não são, para reduzir a nada as que são;
verses.en_web: and God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that are not, that he might bring to nothing the things that are:
verses.en_bbe: And the low things of the world, and the things without honour, did God make selection of, yes, even the things which are not, so that he might make as nothing the things which are:

verses.en: That no flesh should glory in his presence.
verses.pt: para que nenhum mortal se glorie na presença de Deus.
verses.en_web: that no flesh should boast before God.
verses.en_bbe: So that no flesh might have glory before God.

verses.en: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:
verses.pt: Mas vós sois dele, em Cristo Jesus, o qual para nós foi feito por Deus sabedoria, e justiça, e santificação, e redenção;
verses.en_web: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption:
verses.en_bbe: But God has given you a place in Christ Jesus, through whom God has given us wisdom and righteousness and salvation, and made us holy:

verses.en: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
verses.pt: para que, como está escrito: Aquele que se gloria, glorie-se no Senhor.
verses.en_web: that, according as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
verses.en_bbe: So that, as it is said in the holy Writings, Whoever has a desire for glory, let his glory be in the Lord.
